    category: str

    count: int

    summary: list[CategorySummary]

    query=f"Here are my 100 most recent transactions. Please categorize them (e.g., Groceries, Rent, Utilities, Entertainment, etc.) and provide a summary of the total amount spent per category for the current year. \n\nTransactions: {transactions}",
